channel.title: Today Cooking
channel.desc: Wake up to deliciousness with Curtis and Paula Eakins on 3ABN Today Cooking! In this episode, they'll show you how easy and tasty healthy mornings can be. From golden Baked French Toast drizzled with sweet Mixed Berry Syrup, to a hearty Tofu Spinach Scramble, and even Spicy Mock Breakfast Sausage. You'll find breakfast both fun and nourishing. Join Curtis and Paula for laughter, practical tips, and mouthwatering recipes that make breakfast the best meal of the day.
